llamacpp-cuda.reason: llama.cpp's server-cuda image as ghcr.io served it when the template was chosen.

llamacpp-metal.reason: Upstream's macOS arm64 release build b12283, which carries its Metal library beside the binary.

llamacpp-rocm.reason: server-rocm b12063 (2cbca389f), built on ROCm 7.2.1 by upstream's .devops/rocm.Dockerfile; amd64 only.

llamacpp-vulkan.reason: server-vulkan b11681, the build halo has run its embedder on.

mlxlm-metal.reason: The mlx-lm 0.32.2 wheel from PyPI, its dependencies (mlx among them) resolved as PyPI stood on 2026-10-17.

omlx-metal.reason: Upstream oMLX 0.8.3's CPython 3.12 release wheel, pinned by the sha256 GitHub states for it, its PyPI dependencies resolved as PyPI stood on 2026-11-23. It has the operator's decode and MTP-depth changes (#5395, #5525, #5527) but not the indexer batching (#5549), the 2-bit code decoding (#5555) or the batched drafter.

vllm-ngc.reason: NVIDIA's NGC build of vLLM, the one bginf's Qwen3.6 ran.

vllm-rocm.reason: vLLM's own ROCm release image, the same as its v0.33.0-rocm100 tag (ROCm 10.0); amd64 only.
